BB28 Wednesday Veto Ep Recap, Week 10

Also available on YouTube.

Big Brother 28 is in full swing, with shifting alliances and new deals creating tension as the house edges closer to a crucial double eviction. With Rob out of town, Taran Armstrong is joined by Kirsten MacInnis and Aman Adwin for this recap episode, diving into a two-hour Veto competition and dissecting the moves and motives shaping the game.

This episode breaks down a packed week in the BB28 house: Yash navigates a tricky bribe twist during his HoH reign, balancing a promised deal with the Icons alliance while considering whether to give Taylor or an Icon a shot at the Power of Veto. The houseguests face a physically demanding, 13-hour Veto competition themed around the “pressure cooker,” though both Taran and Kirsten debate if it’s really the same classic competition fans remember. Emotional family videos add a boost for some, but create anxiety for others, especially Melody and Taylor, who wonder what’s unsaid. As Drew wins Veto after an intense standoff and swears on his real sister instead of a fake cousin, everyone’s next moves come into question.

Taran notes Yash’s loyalty test with the Icons and the blurred lines of the bribe twist

Kirsten points out how Melody uses the house phone as a coping mechanism, giving her a healthy outlet for emotions

Aman highlights Drew’s negotiation and the impact of swearing on a real family member in a crucial Veto win

Kirsten observes that Taylor and Yash sense something amiss from their family videos, affecting their confidence

The hosts discuss how the Icons still target Yash despite his loyalty and how Drew’s new secrecy shifts alliance dynamics

With double eviction on the horizon and trust running thin, alliances face tough choices. Will Yash and Drew stick to their deal, or will new cracks push them in different directions? Listen to the full recap for all the details and get ready for the next big move inside the Big Brother 28 house.
